### (Admissions will be announced after ECAT-2024. Only those candidate will be able to apply who will appear in ECAT-2024, being conducted by UET Lahore.)

### Application Processing Fee [For [Group 01](<https://admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk/Admission_Eligibility.php>) and [Group 02](<https://admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk/Admission_Eligibility.php>) sepearate application processing fee is required]

Application processing fee of Rs. 4000/- can be deposited through HBL digital banking against candidate's CNIC/Form-B number by following any of below mentioned modes:

1. Non HBL Account Holders (Konnect App, Konnect Shops/Agents) selecting "UET Taxila Admission Processing"
2. HBL Account Holders (HBL Internet Banking, HBL Mobile App) selecting "UET Taxila Admission Processing"

Without application fee your application will not be considered.

To view the detailed process of "how to submit application processing fee" [Click Here](<https://admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk/ApplicationProcessingFee.php>)

### Instructions for Online Filling of Application Form (F-I) [For [Group 01](<https://admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk/Admission_Eligibility.php>) and [Group 02](<https://admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk/Admission_Eligibility.php>) sepearate online application forms (F-I) are required]

1. Visit the nearest designated TCS Center [(TCS Centers)](<https://admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk/ProspectusAvailability.php>) for submission of application processing fee Rs. 1500/- **(Rs. 1450/- Application Processing Fee + Rs. 50/- TCS Charges)** and obtain computerized deposit slip having  **15 digit**   **Ref #** [If 14 digit, make it 15 by adding 0 to the extreme left].
   - Please, provide your ECAT roll number as registration number to TCS Staff
   - Please, ask TCS Staff to deposit admission application processing fee for UET Taxila
2. Submit Fee **Rs. 1700/-** (Prospectus Charges + Processing Fee + TCS chargers)
   in TCS center and get receipt having consignment number (CN No.).
3. Fee will be submitted in HBL UET Taxila **Account Title: 'UET Taxila Recurring'
   No. 19157900213501** on deposit slip available in HBL UET, Taxila. In this case
   the candidate will submit only **Rs. 1450/-** (Prospectus Charges + Processing
   Fee paid at once). **Ref #**
4. Visit online admission portal [admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk](<https://admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk/>)
   and click on MY UET button for registration with UET Taxila.
5. For registration click registration button and provide the following information.
   1. CNIC/Form B number without dashes.
   2. Set your password
   3. TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent Roll No. (Not Required for BS Mathematics and Physics)
   4. TCS **Ref # (15 digit)** [If 14 digit, make it 15 by adding 0 to the extreme left]
   5. Deposit date
   6. Name of TCS Center
   7. Upload the image of deposit slip
6. Sign in now.
7. Fill the personnel information educational information, applicable options and preference
   and submit it online.
8. The applicant can sign in again and again in to see/edit his/her data until the submission
   of application online.
9. While filling the preference table, fill the column for preference very carefully. The order
   of preference once given shall be final and cannot be changed subsequently of the submission
   of application for online.
10. Under the column Category choose only among “A” (open merit), “S” (Partially Subsidized) and “X” (children of overseas
    Pakistani). The other categories will be adjusted
    automatically depending upon his applicable option.
11. As per schedule mentioned at [admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk](<https://admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk/>)
    check merit lists.
12. If the name of applicant appears in the merit list, he will visit his "My UET" account for further instructions.
13. The applicant will upload all required documents as per the instructiuons at "My UET" account.
14. The admission offer to “Not Eligible” candidates will
    be cancelled whereas the “Eligible” candidates will be issued call letter and bank challan.
15. After depositing fee in HBL, UET, Taxila branch the candidate will submit the following
    documents in the Admission Office within the time period of a particular merit list:
    1. Bank Challan receipt in support of the University Dues deposited in the Habib Bank
       Ltd. University of Engineering and Technology Taxila Branch.
    2. Medical Certificate (F-V) duly signed and stamped by the District Medical
       Superintendent or the Medical Office of the University or a Commissioned Medical
       officer.
    3. Ten attested and most recent photographs.
    4. Attested Certificate of parent’s /guardian’s income.
    5. Original degrees, certificates and result card of SSC, HSSC, BSc, GCE(A), Diploma of
       Associate Engineers or the equivalent qualifications and their duplicate attested
       photocopies.
    6. Original Marks Sheet of Entry Test
    7. Original NCC certificate (if applicable)
    8. Original Domicile certificate
    9. Attested copy of National CNIC/Form B
    10. Bio-Data Sheet (F-VI) duly completed
    11. Undertaking (F-VII) on a Stamp Paper of Rs. 50/- (Stamp Paper also attested by
        1st Class Magistrate/Oath Commissioner
16. **Notification of
    Selection**
    A list of selectees will be displayed on official University web site.
17. **Important consideration in
    next merit lists:** Admissions are granted on merit and according
    to preferences given by the applicants. An
    applicant who secures admission in a discipline
    of his lower preference and he desires to be
    considered in next merit lists, MUST pay the 1st semester dues of university and upload
    all the required documents on "My UET" account. If he fails to do so, his name would
    be excluded from any future merit lists and his
    admission would be cancelled.
18. **Freezing in any given Discipline and
    Category**
    If an applicant requests in writing to retain the discipline and category in which he has
    been selected for admission
    on merit, then he will not have any right to claim his admission in any other discipline and
    category of higher or
    lower merit if a seat falls vacant in any discipline. Applicant desiring to freeze
    category/discipline should have to
    apply in person on prescribed form for this purpose before the next merit list is displayed.
19. **Relaxation on Time
    Limit**
    If a selectee is prevented by unavoidable circumstances from timely fulfilment of the
    requirements laid down in 29.1 and 29.2 (Admission 2024 Guidelines / Prospectus). he should intimate the
    Convener Admission Committee
    about it within prescribed time limit along with relevant documentary proof. The Convener
    Admission Committee may at his discretion, grant relaxation in the time limit, which shall not
    exceed Three Days.
20. **Forfeiture of Right for
    Admission**
    A selectee who fails to fulfill the requirements laid down in 29.1 and 29.2 (Admission 2024 Guidelines / Prospectus) within the
    prescribed time limit shall forfeit his right
    of admission and will not be considered in
    subsequent merit lists.
21. **Provisional Admission**
    On fulfillment of the obligations mentioned in 29.1 and 29.2 (Admission 2024 Guidelines / Prospectus) a selectee
    will be admitted to
    the university. This admission shall, however, be provisional un till all the original
    degrees or certificates, submitted by him, have been verified for their veracity.
